text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The murmuring of a mountain stream,
the rustling
of the leaves... They are the
unfiltered workings
of the forest.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It is nature, pure and simple.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With our racing schedule having calmed
down, we decide to use the hot springs
tickets we won in a
raffle to take a short
vacation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way to the inn, we take a stroll
through a
lush forest nearby.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, can you feel that, Trainer? The
forest is
breathing.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A katabatic wind is carrying the scent of
leaves and earth down towards us... I
smell hints of oak,
camphor, and
camellia.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And from over there, a fragrant breeze is
carrying
the scent of wildflowers.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Now listen...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It's the fluttering wind of wings—one
pair, two
pairs... Off into the sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr shows far more interest
in the
dense forest around us than the
hot springs
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Assuming she'll be engrossed for a little
while
longer, I wait patiently, but then...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Oh my, this won't do.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This is your trip as well,
Trainer. Is there
anywhere
you'd like to visit?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She makes an unexpected suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
There are a number of sightseeing spots
nearby. Alternatively, we could take a
leisurely soak in
the hot springs at the
inn.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like she's worried I might be
bored. I'm
pretty sure she'd be happiest
staying put and
enjoying nature, though.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, you would?
choice_data_list: Uhm... I think I'd like to stay he...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Actually, I was thinking the same
thing.
Well then... let's linger a little
longer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We end up spending the whole day
enjoying
nature's company.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That was a lovely bath. Did you enjoy
yours?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Good.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The early evening breeze is beckoning.
Shall we
go for a little stroll?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Such a splendid sky. The deeper the
darkness, the
brighter the glow of the
stars.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I hear the murmur of a stream from over
there.
Or, if we head up the hill, we'll be
closer to the sky. Do you have a
preference?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr is like the wind. She's
unbound
by worldly matters, and pays
little mind to her
surroundings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her behavior this afternoon and her
general
efforts to involve me are
honestly a little unusual
for her.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Different?
choice_data_list: You seem a little different than u...
You seem a little different than u...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
choice_data_list: I get the feeling... they're reall...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember the autumn Tenno
Sho?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr's performance there
was so
magnificent that she essentially
attained a new
state of being.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: On that day, I became the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A wind so light, so fast, and so free that
the air
currents around me felt closer to
a hassle than
anything.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And it's because there was another
wind—a wind
that pushed me forward as
I struggled, and blew
as one with me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Powerful, but not wild. Gentle, yet not
weak.
Uplifting, while still coursing
straight forward...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It was the strongest, warmest wind of
all... It was
your wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Even now, that wind is here with me.
And the
more I feel it, the more precious
it becomes to
me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It feels as dear to me as the budding
trees, the shimmering waves, the
fluttering birds, and the
blooming
wildflowers.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...To think that there's such warmth right
here
beside me. Perhaps that's why I
can't help but be
mindful of it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr turns somewhat
formally to face
me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume can change things by
forming
connections... and I believe they
themselves
change too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A gust of wind ruffles her hair.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, then it holds true for
our
connection, too. That's what I
believe.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Together, we'll once again race across
the turf,
across the earth, and through
the sky... towards a
greater tempest.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Together, we can do it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I've had this belief since that day, and
it's not
going anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Yamanin Zephyr and I have
formed
an irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
